title: Executive Scorecards Rules
description: Rules encoding DORA and SPACE metrics for executive visibility. These rules ensure Predictability, Adherencia (Architecture Drift Index), and Eficiencia across satellite products.

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report deployment frequency. Target: at least once per week to production.
principles.rationale: Evololith Product Vision §6: Deployment Frequency is a core DORA metric. High deployment frequency indicates healthy CD pipeline.
principles.validationQuery: CI/CD pipeline exports deployment frequency metric. Report shows deployments/week to production.

metrics.name: Deployment Frequency
metrics.measurement: Count of production deployments in trailing 4 weeks / 4

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report lead time from commit to production. Target: less than 7 days for medium changes.
principles.rationale: Evololith Product Vision §6: Lead Time measures how quickly changes flow from commit to production. Short lead time indicates efficient pipeline.
principles.validationQuery: CI/CD pipeline exports lead time metric. Report shows median days from first commit to production deployment.

metrics.name: Lead Time for Changes
metrics.measurement: Median time from first commit of a change to production deployment

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report change failure rate. Target: less than 15% of deployments cause failures.
principles.rationale: Evololith Product Vision §6: Change Failure Rate measures the percentage of deployments causing production failures.
principles.validationQuery: CI/CD pipeline exports change failure rate. Report shows % of deployments requiring rollback or hotfix.

metrics.name: Change Failure Rate
metrics.measurement: (Failed deployments / Total deployments) * 100 in trailing 4 weeks

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report MTTR (Mean Time To Restore). Target: less than 1 hour for critical failures.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Time to Restore measures how quickly the team recovers from failures. Low MTTR indicates effective incident response.
principles.validationQuery: Incident management system exports MTTR. Report shows median hours from failure detection to service restoration.

metrics.name: Time to Restore
metrics.measurement: Median time from failure detection to restoration for P1/P2 incidents

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST have observability infrastructure (traces, logs, metrics) operational in production.
principles.rationale: Evololith Product Vision §6: Reliability ensures production systems are observable. Evolith ADR-0007 mandates OpenTelemetry.
principles.validationQuery: Production observability dashboard accessible. OpenTelemetry traces flowing. Error rate < 1%.

metrics.name: Error Rate
metrics.measurement: (Failed requests / Total requests) * 100 in trailing 24 hours

principles.statement: Satellite products SHOULD measure team health quarterly. Target: > 70% positive sentiment.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Culture measures team satisfaction and health. Teams that are healthy ship higher quality.
principles.validationQuery: Team health survey conducted quarterly. Results stored in product documentation. Trend tracked.

metrics.name: Team Health Score
metrics.measurement: % positive responses in quarterly team health survey

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report sprint throughput. Target: > 80% of committed work delivered.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Execution measures delivery effectiveness. Consistent throughput indicates predictable pipeline.
principles.validationQuery: Sprint metrics exported. Report shows % of story points delivered vs committed in trailing 4 sprints.

metrics.name: Sprint Throughput
metrics.measurement: (Delivered story points / Committed story points) * 100 in trailing 4 sprints

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST have current SDLC state visible to all stakeholders. Target: phase gate status updated within 24h.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Communication ensures stakeholders have real-time visibility into development state.
principles.validationQuery: Phase gate status board accessible. Updates made within 24h of state change. All stakeholders have access.

metrics.name: Gate Status Freshness
metrics.measurement: Max time between state change and status board update

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST have executive sponsor assigned and actively engaged. Sponsor must review quarterly status.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Sponsorship ensures leadership alignment. Active sponsorship prevents strategic drift.
principles.validationQuery: evolith.yaml includes governance.executiveSponsor field. Quarterly review meeting documented.

metrics.name: Executive Engagement
metrics.measurement: Count of executive sponsor reviews in trailing quarter

principles.statement: Satellite products MUST measure and report Architecture Drift Index. Target: < 10% drift from Evolith Core standards.
principles.rationale: Evolith Product Vision §6: Adherence measured via Architecture Drift Index. Drift > threshold indicates erosion of governance.
principles.validationQuery: Evolith CLI validate command run monthly. Report shows % of rules failed vs total applicable rules.

governance.complianceVerification: DORA+SPACE metrics verified quarterly during governance review. Evolith CLI validate command provides drift index.
governance.exceptionProcess: Architecture Board review required when any metric exceeds target for 2+ consecutive quarters.
governance.dashboardRequirements: Metrics marked dashboardRequired: true MUST be visible in Evolith Tracker or equivalent executive dashboard.
governance.reportingCadence: DORA metrics reported monthly. SPACE metrics reported quarterly.
